_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Du bis Speler {player_id}, die {num_rounds} runde van Iterated Ultimatum Game speelt.
Du häös ${pool} óm te dele in deze runde tösse dich en Speler {other_id}.

Veursteler:
  - Maak 'n aanbod: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Es 't aanbod weurt aangenómme → Du kriegs $(pool - X), de anger speler kriegs $X
  - Es 't aanbod weurt aafgeweze → Beide kriege $0
  - Veurbeeld: [Offer: $3]  of  'Ich vinde dit eerlik. [Offer: $5]'

Reagerende:
  - Beslót euver 't aanbod mit [Accept] of [Reject]
  - Veurbeeld: 'Det sjèntj mie redelik. [Accept]'
            'Te oneerlik. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Runde {round_number} begint! ---
Speler {proposer_id} is de voorsteler, Speler {responder_id} is de reagerende.
round.offer: Runde {round_number}: Speler {proposer_id} deilt ${offer} aan Speler {responder_id} (en hilt ${keep}).
round.accepted: Speler {responder_id} haet 't aanbod aangenómme! Runde {round_number} wint: Speler {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Speler {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Nuuj totale: Speler 0: ${total_0}, Speler 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Speler {responder_id} haet 't aanbod aafgeweze! Runde {round_number} wint: Beide speulers +$0. Totale blieve: Speler 0: ${total_0}, Speler 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: De veursteller moot 'n biedrage make mèt de vorm [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: 't Aanbodsbedraag moot ein geldig gans getal zeen.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Gein aktueel aanbod om te reagere.

outcome.win: Speler {winner} haet gewonne mit ${winner_total} totaal taenge Speler {loser} z'n ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Allebei de speulers eindige mèt ${total} totaal.
